Package eu.algites.lib.action.execution.transaction

Interface AIiTransactionFinalizationAction<CI extends eu.algites.lib.action.execution.engine.AIiActionInput,CO extends eu.algites.lib.action.execution.engine.AIiActionOutput,FC extends AIiTransactionFinalizationContext,AF extends AIiTransactionActionFailureContext,CF extends AIiTransactionCommitFailureContext<CO>>

Type Parameters:
CI - commit input type
CO - commit output type
FC - specialized commit execution context
AF - specialized action-failure context
CF - specialized commit-failure context
public interface AIiTransactionFinalizationAction<CI extends eu.algites.lib.action.execution.engine.AIiActionInput,CO extends eu.algites.lib.action.execution.engine.AIiActionOutput,FC extends AIiTransactionFinalizationContext,AF extends AIiTransactionActionFailureContext,CF extends AIiTransactionCommitFailureContext<CO>>
Preconfigured transaction-local finalization strategy. The commit method creates the intended final effect; onActionFailure handles pre-commit action failures, and onCommitFailure handles commitAction failures. They are not after-transaction observers. Exceptions are journaled and may leave the transaction in an incomplete/unknown rollback state.
